raw_text: Bellingcat has geolocated new construction activity at approximately 33.7553N, 78.7260E on the northern shore of Pangong Tso, corresponding to the Finger 8 area. Comparison of Sentinel-2 imagery from December 2023 and January 2024 reveals a linear structure spanning a narrow channel. Shadow analysis indicates the structure is approximately 4 metres above water level, consistent with a military-grade pontoon or prefabricated bridge. Chinese military vehicles are visible in staging areas approximately 800 metres east of the construction site.
